scope: Whole fixed work doi:10.5802/jep.235 read once end to end in the publisher-native TeX; this file anchors each of the 40 numbered positions to native lines, printed headings and original reader pages so the retained item C and its exclusions stay checkable.

native_line_number_basis.source: same cached fixed original reused and parsed; no new download and no new content hash in this batch

page_number_basis.basis: 25 page headers carrying a single printed folio in 868..916

numbering_note: 40 numbered positions of the fixed native TeX, each matched in order against the line-initial heading of the publisher reader.pdf layout text. No candidate was left unmatched in either direction: the 42 extracted heading-shaped lines contain 2 in-text cross-references (p6 "Lemma 3.1)" inside Remark 1.1 and p27 "Lemma 3.4 allows us to conclude"), which the ordered walk skips. Assumption and Theorem carry no [section] argument, so they run continuously (Assumption 1-8, Theorem 1-6); Lemma, Corollary, Remark and Example are section-scoped. Appendix headings print as A.1, A.2, B.1, C.1.

heading_position_check.method: pdftotext -layout; heading = line-initial environment word + printed number token

visual_check.note: Only the cover and the first printed page (physical 2, printed 867) were viewed, at 100 dpi, to confirm the journal masthead and the printed folio rule. No further page was viewed in this batch and no diagram was judged; the full 51-page reader is the shared original.

figure_check.basis: 原生 TeX 无 figure、table 或 tikz 环境，唯一一处 \includegraphics 在第11行（\raggedleft\includegraphics[scale=.5]{titre-jep}），是前置的期刊刊头图，不是数学图件；正文的图形式内容仅有 equation/align 等行间公式，没有需要目视核对的图形。

line_number_convention: All native line numbers are 1-based lines of the complete retained TeX (1952 lines). The transported item items/2507_author_proof.tex is an independent excerpt and is not used as a line basis here.
